blocks.text: Elastic spring se bandhi kamiyat

Kamiyat m wala jism lein jo spring constant k wale spring se hamwar ufqi satah par bandha hai (Fig 14.2). Shuru mein yeh O, darmiyani jagah, par rest mein hai. Aik quwwat F ise O se A tak daen taraf displacement x se hatati hai. Hooke ke qanoon se lagayi gayi quwwat displacement ke mutanasib hai: F = kx (14.1). Spring jism par barabar miqdar aur ulti simt ki elastic restoring force lagata hai: F = -kx (14.2). Jab lagayi quwwat hata li jaye to jism O ki taraf wapas aata, apni inertia ki wajah se O se aage B tak jata jahan spring dab jata hai, wapas aata, aur yun A aur B ke darmiyan jhoolta hai.

Newton ke doosre qanoon se F = ma (14.3). (14.2) se muqabla karne par ma = -kx, is liye a = -(k/m) x (14.4). Kyunke k/m constant hai, a = -(constant) x, ya a mutanasib -x. Yeh simple harmonic motion ki riyazi shakal hai: S.H.M. karne wale jism ka acceleration hamesha us ke displacement ke barah-e-raast mutanasib aur hamesha darmiyani jagah ki taraf hota hai.

Time period aur frequency: a = -(k/m)x ko a = -w^2 x se milane par w^2 = k/m, is liye w = (k/m) ka square root. Kyunke w = 2 pi f, f = (1/2 pi) x (k/m) ka square root aur T = 1/f = 2 pi x (m/k) ka square root.

blocks.alt: Teen qataron mein hamwar farsh par deewar se bandhe spring par kamiyat m. Oopar: darmiyani jagah O par rest mein, dashed amudi lakeer se nishan zada. Darmiyan: A tak kheencha gaya, O se x faasla daen; spring F = -kx se wapas kheenchta, surkh teer baen. Neeche: chhorne par kamiyat B tak aage chali jati jahan spring dabta, surkh teer daen spring ka wapas dhakelna dikhata. Neeche: F = -kx aur F = ma se a = -(k/m)x = -w^2 x; w = sqrt(k/m), f = (1/2 pi) sqrt(k/m), T = 2 pi sqrt(m/k).
blocks.caption: Spring par kamiyat ka S.H.M. (Fig 14.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Kamiyat jis taraf bhi ho, spring ki quwwat O ki taraf wapas hoti hai, aur O se jitna door ho utni zyada. Yahi S.H.M. ki shart a = -(constant) x hai.

blocks.title: Ghaur karein
blocks.text: S.H.M. ke usool ke haqeeqi istemal mein pendulum ghariyan, musiqi ke saaz aur gariyon ke suspension nizam shamil hain.
Misal 14.1

S.H.M. karne wale zarre ki angular frequency 2 rad s^-1 hai. Is ki frequency aur time period maloom karein. Hal: w = 2 pi f, is liye f = w / 2 pi = 2 / 2 pi = 1/pi, taqreeban 0.318 Hz. T = 1/f = pi, taqreeban 3.14 s.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Dutch riyazi-dan, falkiyat-dan aur physicist Christiaan Huygens ne 1656 mein pehli pendulum ghari ka patent liya. Unhon ne simple harmonic motion se pendulum ki lambai aur time period ka riyazi formula nikala. (Kitab ki un ki ghari ki tasveer shamil nahi.)
Simple pendulum

Simple pendulum aik chhota, bhari bob (kamiyat m) hai jo aik mazboot sahare se l lambai ki halki, na khinchne wali dori se latka ho. Jab ise darmiyani jagah O se inteha ki jagah P tak hata kar chhora jaye to O ki taraf restoring force amal karti hai aur bob kashish-e-saql ke tehat mure raaste par aage peeche jhoolta hai (Fig 14.3).

P par dori amudi lakeer se theta zawiya banati hai. Wazan mg ko dori ke saath mg cos(theta) aur us ke amudan mg sin(theta) mein tor sakte hain. Kyunke bob dori ke saath harkat nahi karta, mg cos(theta) aur tension T aik doosre ko khatam karte hain. Hissa mg sin(theta) O ki taraf restoring force hai: F = -mg sin(theta). F = ma se a = -g sin(theta) (14.5). Chhote zawiyon ke liye sin(theta) radian mein theta ke taqreeban barabar hai (Table 14.1), is liye a = -g theta (14.6). Kyunke theta = S/l, jahan S qaus (arc) ki lambai hai, aur chhote zawiyon par displacement x taqreeban S ke barabar hai, a = -(g/l) x (14.7). l aur g constant hon to a mutanasib -x: simple pendulum ki harkat S.H.M. hai.

blocks.title: Chhote zawiye: sin(theta) taqreeban theta
blocks.text: Kitab chhote zawiye ka qadam 'sin(theta) taqreeban 0' chhapti hai. Durust yeh hai ke sin(theta) taqreeban theta (radian mein), jo Table 14.1 dikhata hai aur agli equation a = -g theta use karti hai. Yeh andaza taqreeban 10 darje tak ke zawiyon par achha kaam karta hai.

blocks.caption: Table 14.1 Chhote zawiyon ke liye theta aur sin(theta) ki qeematein

blocks.text: a = -(g/l)x ko a = -w^2 x (14.8) se milane par: w^2 = g/l, is liye w = (g/l) ka square root (14.9). Kyunke w = 2 pi f, f = (1/2 pi) x (g/l) ka square root aur T = 1/f = 2 pi x (l/g) ka square root (14.10). Yun simple pendulum ka period us ki lambai ke square root ke barah-e-raast aur g ke square root ke ulat mutanasib hai; yeh bob ki kamiyat ya (chhote jhoolon mein) amplitude par munhasir nahi. Jis pendulum ka period do second ho use second pendulum kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: l lambai ka pendulum O se guzarti amudi dashed lakeer se theta zawiye par hataya gaya. Bob par tension T dori ke saath oopar, wazan mg seedha neeche, aur mg ko dori ke saath mg cos(theta) aur us ke amudan mg sin(theta) mein bata gaya jo O ki taraf wapas hai. Daen: qadam F = -mg sin(theta), is liye a = -g sin(theta); chhote zawiyon par sin(theta) = theta = x/l; a = -(g/l)x = -w^2 x; w = sqrt(g/l); T = 2 pi sqrt(l/g); g = 4 pi^2 l / T^2.
blocks.caption: Simple pendulum par quwwatein (Fig 14.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sirf wazan ka dori ke aar-paar hissa, mg sin(theta), bob ko wapas kheenchta hai. Chhote zawiyon par yeh displacement ke mutanasib hai, is liye pendulum S.H.M. karta hai.

blocks.text: Simple pendulum se g napna
Pendulum ki lambai l napein, ise chhote amplitude se jhulayein aur stopwatch se T maloom karein. Phir g = 4 pi^2 l / T^2.
Misal 14.2

Jahan g = 9.8 m s^-2 ho wahan second pendulum ki lambai kya hai? Hal: T = 2 s aur T = 2 pi x (l/g) ka square root, is liye T^2 = 4 pi^2 l / g aur l = g T^2 / (4 pi^2) = (9.8 m s^-2)(2 s)^2 / (4 x 3.14^2) = 0.994 m, ya 99.4 cm. Is ki frequency f = 1/T = 0.5 Hz hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Lafz pendulum Latin lafz pendulus se nikla hai, jis ka matlab latakta hua hai.
Dimagh ki kasrat

blocks.prompt: Tamam thartharate jism awaz paida karte hain. Thartharata simple pendulum sunne wali awaz kyun paida nahi karta?
blocks.explanation: Is ki frequency bohat kam hai (second pendulum ki taqreeban 0.5 Hz); hum sirf taqreeban 20 Hz se 20 kHz sun sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Pendulum Lahore se Karachi le jaya jaye to kya us ka time period badlega? Kya chaand par wahi hoga?
blocks.explanation: Bohat thora: khat-e-istiwa ke qareeb g thora kam hai, is liye Karachi mein T bohat thora lamba hai. Chaand par g zameen ka taqreeban 1/6 hai, is liye T taqreeban 6 ka square root (taqreeban 2.45) guna lamba hai.

blocks.prompt: Simple pendulum ka period napte waqt chhota amplitude kyun mashwara diya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Formula T = 2 pi x (l/g) ka square root sin(theta) taqreeban theta par mabni hai, jo sirf chhote zawiyon (taqreeban 10 darje tak) par durust hai; bare jhoolon ka period thora lamba hota hai.

items: Pendulum: restoring force mg sin(theta); chhote zawiye: a = -(g/l)x; T = 2 pi sqrt(l/g).
